review: independent bounded guest-chat Store candidate adjudication

runtime_evidence.artifact_integrity: matches release receipt and test result; result says unchanged after run
runtime_evidence.guest_state: fresh profile, Chat visible, no auth token/profile/organization; same guest state verified after panel reload
runtime_evidence.page_grounding: test result reports nonce and all workflow terms in first completed answer; screenshot shows the three stages and no gate/error
runtime_evidence.after_reload: test result reports follow-up completed, unpredictable code and fixture heading; screenshot shows heading and answer
runtime_evidence.resource_run: resource journal records admitted, healthy watcher, child exit 0, and valid final decision

strengths: Generates unpredictable opening/follow-up codes and fixture heading, inserts them into the visible primary article, and checks the page reader clone contains them.

Requires the page-specific opening code plus all three workflow terms in a completed guest answer, then reloads the real side panel and requires a new guest answer with its own code and fixture heading.
Checks guest storage state before and after reload and hashes the unpacked release tree against the receipt after the run.
limits: The result has guest_ai_requests=[] even though the source contains a network observer; the run does not assert an observed request, so transport-level proof is absent.

The follow-up screenshot renders the code as [follow-up-code], while the structured result reports a nonce match; the code-to-answer check is therefore supported by the runtime assertion/result, not legible screenshot text.
The resource journal proves the harness process was admitted and exited cleanly, but it does not itself bind the process to the result UUID; association is by run record/path and timing.
test_quality.scope_boundary: This evidence covers fresh guest Chat, page grounding, and a post-reload guest follow-up on the immutable 0.2.130 artifact. It does not establish broad Chat certification, account-to-guest privacy transition, or other release behavior.

submission_adjudication: The bounded regression is demonstrated on the immutable candidate. This evidence supports lifting the guest-chat regression hold for 0.2.130; it does not itself submit to the Store.
